trust.en: I didn't trust Tom and he didn't trust me, either.
trust.zh: 我不信任汤姆而且汤姆也不信任我。

touch.en: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
touch.zh: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。

truth.en: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
truth.zh: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。

test.en: Tom didn't have enough time to answer all the questions on the test.
test.zh: 汤姆考试时没时间答完所有题。

truck.en: Tom was admiring my new car at the time the truck crashed into it.
truck.zh: 在汤姆欣赏我的新车的同时，一辆卡车撞了过来。

thought.en: Tom said he thought he might be the only one who had to do that.
thought.zh: 汤姆说他以为需要做那件事的就只有他一个。

thick.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.
thick.zh: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。

trunk.en: Go upstairs and bring down my trunk.
trunk.zh: 上楼把我的旅行箱拿下来。

treat.en: Why do you let Tom treat you that way?
treat.zh: 你为甚么让汤姆那么对待你？

taste.en: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.
taste.zh: 刚开始的时候你可能不会喜欢这个啤酒。这是需要多次品尝去习惯它的口味。

tire.en: Could you check the tire pressure?
tire.zh: 你能检查一下这个轮胎的气压吗？

thief.en: Give a thief enough rope and he'll hang himself.

tiger.en: Rather than live a hundred years as a rabbit, live one day as a tiger.
tiger.zh: 宁可当只老虎活一天，也不愿当只兔子过一百年。

turning.en: The world is just like a book, and every step you take is like turning a page.
turning.zh: 世界就像是一本书，走一步等于翻了一页。

temple.en: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
temple.zh: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？

throat.en: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
throat.zh: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。

team.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.
team.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。

tie.en: Tom was wearing a yellow shirt with a blue tie.
tie.zh: 汤姆穿著一件黄色衬衫，系著一条蓝色领带。

towel.en: This towel is so soft and fluffy. It feels good!
towel.zh: 这条毛巾蓬松又柔软，特别舒服。

tense.en: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.
tense.zh: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。

treatment.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
treatment.zh: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

transfer.en: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
transfer.zh: 我们会用银行转帐付款。

tongue.en: His name was on the tip of my tongue, but I couldn't remember it.
tongue.zh: 我都快要说出他的名字了，可就是记不起来。

terrible.en: Tom can write almost like a native speaker, but his pronunciation is terrible.
terrible.zh: Tom写作可以写的像本国人一样，可是他的发音很烂

trousers.en: I bought two pairs of trousers.

tour.en: How much is the tour per person?

twin.en: He mistook me for my twin brother.
twin.zh: 他把我误认为我的双胞胎兄弟。

turkey.en: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
turkey.zh: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

tractor.en: I can't get my tractor started.
tractor.zh: 我发动不了我的拖拉机。

toy.en: It was her little sister that broke her toy.
toy.zh: 她的玩具是被她妹妹弄坏的。

tidy.en: The cottage was clean and tidy.

tremble.zh: 我感觉到我的手在震动

textbook.en: Tom told me that he had lost his textbook.
textbook.zh: 汤姆告诉我他丢了课本。

therapy.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
therapy.zh: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。

type.en: I'm the type who gets nervous in front of people, so I'm bad at speech making.
type.zh: 我是那种面对人群很紧张的人，所以我的演讲能力很差。

tiny.en: He came from a tiny mountain town.

trap.en: We set a trap to catch a fox.
trap.zh: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。

thorn.en: I have a thorn in my finger.

tax.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.
tax.zh: 他想要减少进口品的税。

teenager.en: I feel like I'm a teenager again.

toward.en: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
toward.zh: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。

temperature.en: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.
temperature.zh: 小孩的体温一般比大人的要高。

track.en: My business has at last gotten on the right track.
track.zh: 我的生意终于走上了正轨。

trim.en: Did you trim the apple trees?

top.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.
top.zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。

tempt.en: I didn't mean to tempt you.

tip.en: His name was on the tip of my tongue, but I couldn't remember it.
tip.zh: 我都快要说出他的名字了，可就是记不起来。

tender.en: My father was no less affectionate and tender to me than my mother was.
tender.zh: 我爸爸对我的爱和照顾不比我妈妈少。

typical.en: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.
typical.zh: 我发现他就是会很晚才来这样的人。

timid.en: A mouse is a timid creature.

towards.en: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
towards.zh: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。

typist.en: She found employment as a typist.

tortoise.en: A hare raced with a tortoise.

target.en: Her success made her the target of jealousy.
target.zh: 她的成功让她受尽嫉妒。

temper.en: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.
temper.zh: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。

traffic.en: You must be careful of the traffic when you cross the street.

total.en: What is the total amount of money you spent?

tune.en: She played a tune on the piano.
tune.zh: 她在钢琴上弹了一首曲子。

tower.en: They wanted a wedding picture in front of the Eiffel Tower.
tower.zh: 他们想在艾菲尔铁塔前面拍张结婚照。

throne.en: Prince William is second in line to the English throne.
throne.zh: 威廉王子是英国王位第二顺位继承人

temptation.en: You shouldn't give in to temptation.
temptation.zh: 你不应该屈服在诱惑之下。

topic.en: I chose this topic because I think that it's interesting.
topic.zh: 我选这个主题是因为我觉得它很有意思。

tape.en: He erased his speech from the tape.
tape.zh: 他把他的那段话从磁带里删除了。

tough.en: Tom certainly has a tough job.
tough.zh: 汤姆确实有个麻烦的工作。

tail.en: Better be the head of a cat than the tail of a lion.

translate.en: It took me more than two hours to translate a few pages of English.
translate.zh: 翻译几页英文花了我2个多小时。

typhoon.en: Because of the typhoon, my parents ended their trip one day early.
typhoon.zh: 因为台风的关系，我的父母提早一天结束了旅行回到家。

translation.en: Which translation of this book do you think is better, the French one or the English one?
translation.zh: 你觉得这本书的哪个译本比较好？法语的还是英语的？

trace.zh: 他没有留下痕迹就消失了。

thoughtful.en: She is very thoughtful and patient.

tightly.en: I hugged him tightly and cried.

tool.en: You'll need a special tool to do it.
tool.zh: 你会需要一个特殊的工具来做这件事。

teaching.en: I don't think that Tom has any teaching experience.
teaching.zh: 我认为汤姆一点教学经验都没有。

toad.en: I cannot distinguish a frog from a toad.
toad.zh: 我无法区分青蛙和蟾蜍。

tube.en: Please buy a tube of toothpaste.

theft.en: The police accused him of theft.

thunder.en: Lightning is usually followed by thunder.

theory.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
theory.zh: 这个理论对我来说太难了，理解不了。

talent.en: I can't help admiring his talent.

thumb.en: My grandmother has a green thumb.

tank.en: The fuel tank in the car is full.

treasure.en: I'll never tell anyone where I've hidden the treasure.
treasure.zh: 我不会把藏宝的地方告诉任何人。

tin.en: Can you distinguish silver from tin?

task.en: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.
task.zh: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。

tight.en: These shoes are too tight. They hurt.

title.en: What is the title of your new book?

telegram.en: Send us a telegram when you arrive.
telegram.zh: 当你到的时候发一份电报给我们。

tend.en: Red-haired people tend to have freckles.

transmission.en: Can you drive a manual transmission?

thoroughly.en: Because Tom didn't thoroughly clean the pots, Mary got dysentery.
thoroughly.zh: 汤姆没有彻底清洗锅碗瓢盆，导致玛莉得了痢疾。

toast.en: I always have coffee and toast for breakfast.
toast.zh: 我的早餐总是咖啡和土司。

traditional.en: Their traditional life style no longer exists.
traditional.zh: 他们传统的生活方式不再存在。

tent.en: It took us half an hour to set up the tent.
tent.zh: 搭帐篷花了我们半小时。

tunnel.en: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
tunnel.zh: 这条隧道是那条的两倍长。

thesis.en: Have you finished writing your thesis?

tone.en: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.
tone.zh: 他不知道他自己五音不全。

theme.en: What is the theme of his latest novel?
theme.zh: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？

tolerate.en: I can't tolerate this noise any longer.
tolerate.zh: 我不能再忍受这个噪音了。

tow.en: The policeman didn't tow your car away.

tomato.en: The tomato is a vegetable, not a fruit.
tomato.zh: 番茄是蔬菜而不是水果。

trade.en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.

trick.en: You're not trying to trick me, are you?

tread.en: Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
tread.zh: 天使畏惧处, 愚人敢闯入。

territory.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.

trial.en: Tom's trial will continue on October 20th.
trial.zh: 汤姆的审判将于 10 月 20 日继续进行。

term.en: We have two examinations during this term.
term.zh: 这个学期我们有两次考试。

temporary.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

tailor.en: Father always has the tailor make his suits.
tailor.zh: 父亲总是让这位裁缝师为他做西装。

thread.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.
thread.zh: 我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。

tragic.en: They both cried after hearing the tragic news.
tragic.zh: 听到这件悲剧，他俩尽皆哭泣。

tear.en: They will tear down the old building in two days.
tear.zh: 他们将在两天内拆除这栋旧的建筑物。

triumph.en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
triumph.zh: 只要好人袖手旁观，恶人就会得胜。

tendency.en: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
tendency.zh: 在我看来，她有一种夸张的倾向。

tomb.en: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.

tag.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?
tag.zh: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？

technology.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
technology.zh: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。

terrain.en: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
terrain.zh: 地面高低不平，给部队前进带来了困难。

tropical.en: This kind of plant grows only in the tropical regions.
tropical.zh: 这类植物只生长在热带地区。

treaty.en: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
treaty.zh: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。

tighten.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.
tighten.zh: 中小企业要勒紧裤带才能存活。

tuna.en: The skin of a shark is much rougher than that of a tuna fish.
tuna.zh: 鲨鱼皮比金枪鱼皮粗糙多了。

telescope.en: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
telescope.zh: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？

treason.en: In some countries, the punishment for treason can be life in prison.
treason.zh: 在一些国家，叛国罪的惩罚可以是终身监禁。

texture.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
texture.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。

tap.en: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.
tap.zh: 自来水有可能含有氯、铅等有害物质。

throughout.en: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
throughout.zh: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。
